data.one_liner: A Flutter widget library for building card‑based settings screens.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑made SettingsList, SettingsSection, and SettingsTile widgets to create settings UIs that look like Android 16 QPR. Supports navigation, switches, checkboxes, radios, and adaptive layouts.
use_when: You need a quick, Material‑only settings screen without writing custom widgets
You want a consistent card‑style appearance across Android, iOS, desktop, and other platforms
avoid_when: You need deep customization beyond the provided tile types
strengths: Minimal API, similar to the popular settings_ui package
Adaptive tile height and maxWidth support for better layout
Pure Dart, works on all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Few tile types compared to full‑featured form libraries
No built‑in theming beyond Material 3 defaults
